small.title: * _iPhone with Face ID:_ Simultaneously press and hold the side button and either volume button until the sliders appear
small.header_path: Turn iPhone on or off > Turn off iPhone
small.preview:
* _iPhone with Face ID:_ Simultaneously press and hold the side button and either volume button until the sliders appear, then drag the Power Off slider.
* _iPhone with the Home button:_ Press and hold the side button, then drag the slider.
